start: A gym owner sent a UPI reference for Pro monthly; the money is in the bank

steps.action: Open 'Payments' (or tap the payments line on Needs you)
user_sees: Heading 'Payments' with 'Show' on waiting
Card: gym name · code · Open gym, amount, plan and reference
must_not: Payments of other statuses mixed in

steps.action: Type a note ('Note for the log (optional)') and tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: Question ending 'Only confirm when the money is in the bank. Go ahead?'
must_not: Confirmed with no question

steps.action: Answer yes
user_sees: The page reloads without that card
The gym's plan and paid-until moved on 1 month
must_not: The plan moved on twice
The free days of a trial lost

steps.action: Change 'Show' to the confirmed list
user_sees: Each payment with its outcome words
must_not: Waiting payments in this list

steps.action: Tap 'Open gym' on a card
user_sees: The gym's HQ page
must_not: Another gym

start: A waiting payment with no matching money in the bank

steps.action: Leave 'Why not' empty and tap 'Not confirmed', answer yes
user_sees: A refusal asking for a reason (exact words unknown: the database decides)
must_not: A rejection with no reason for the owner

steps.action: Type 'No payment with this reference arrived', tap 'Not confirmed', answer yes
user_sees: The card leaves the waiting list
must_not: The gym's plan changed

steps.action: In a second tab tap 'Confirm' on the same payment
user_sees: 'That payment is already confirmed or not confirmed. The page was refreshed.'
must_not: The plan moved on after a rejection

start: A payment HQ did not confirm earlier

steps.action: Change 'Show' to the not-confirmed list
user_sees: The rejected payment with its reason
must_not: A Confirm button on a payment already handled

steps.action: Wait for the owner to send a new reference
user_sees: A new waiting card for the same gym
must_not: The old rejected payment turned back to waiting

steps.action: Read a waiting card
user_sees: Gym name, code, amount, plan, reference; no member data
must_not: The page open to anyone without the HQ sign-in

steps.action: Reject with a reason
user_sees: The reason is the only HQ text the gym owner sees
must_not: The log note ('Note for the log') shown to the owner

start: Owner signed in online, free trial running, MettleUp payment details set

steps.action: Open Settings, then Pay MettleUp
user_sees: 'Pay for MettleUp by UPI or bank transfer, and see when your payment is confirmed.'
Plans with prices and a UPI QR code
must_not: A QR code with a wrong amount

steps.action: Pay by UPI in a UPI app
user_sees: The UPI app shows MettleUp as payee and the amount
must_not: Another payee name

steps.action: Under '3. I have paid' type the 12-digit UPI reference and tap 'Send for confirmation'
user_sees: 'Sending…' then a line 'Waiting for confirmation' at the top
must_not: The payment sent twice
The plan changed before MettleUp confirms

steps.action: Open Pay MettleUp again after HQ confirmed
user_sees: 'Confirmed: paid until <date>'
'… Thank you!'
must_not: The free days of the trial lost

start: The free trial is in its last 14 days

steps.action: Tap 'Pay MettleUp' on the trial banner
user_sees: The Pay MettleUp screen
must_not: The price list opening instead

start: Front desk login; then the owner with 3 payments already waiting

steps.action: Front desk opens Settings, Pay MettleUp
user_sees: 'Only the gym owner can pay MettleUp'
'Sign in as the owner, with the gym online, to pay.'
must_not: The pay form shown to the desk

steps.action: Owner sends a 4th reference with 'Send for confirmation'
user_sees: 'You have 3 payments waiting for confirmation. Wait for MettleUp to check them first.'
must_not: A 4th waiting payment saved

start: A payment HQ did not confirm

steps.action: Open Pay MettleUp
user_sees: 'Not confirmed'
'… Reason: <HQ reason>. Check the reference number and send it again, or message MettleUp.'
must_not: 'Reason: not given' when HQ wrote one

steps.action: Send the right reference with 'Send for confirmation'
user_sees: A new 'Waiting for confirmation' line above the old one
must_not: The old line changed or removed

steps.action: Open Pay MettleUp on a front-desk login of the same gym
user_sees: No payment list for the desk
must_not: The desk seeing the amount and reference

steps.action: Read the payment line
user_sees: Only this gym's payments
must_not: Another gym's payment
